### Vehicle and diagnostic setup

- Model year, engine and power rating
- Diagnostic app and version
- OBD adapter model
- ECU name or software version, if available

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| First reading | | | |
| Second reading | | | |

If the readings span a refill, note the amount added and when you took the second reading. If the tool shows the diagnostic mode or service, PID or DID, and ECU address, include those alongside the raw reply.

### Reproduction notes

Describe the ignition state and the diagnostic app screen or profile you used. Share only read-only observations from your own vehicle or a vehicle you have permission to test. Remove VIN, licence plate, Bluetooth address and unrelated diagnostic data before posting.
